introHtml: Unisex buttons, stickers, and patches appeal to any audience without gender-specific designs, making them ideal for company swag, event giveaways, or safety campaigns. Whether you are ordering custom embroidered patches for a team uniform or peel-and-stick stickers for a product launch, these versatile items work for everyone. Choose from standard sizes like 2.25-inch buttons or 3-inch patches, and decorate with full-color printing or woven labels for a professional finish.
